description: The chart is a 3D grouped bar visualization illustrating the metric of answer correctness (labeled “Accuracy”) across different language models and different reasoning-task types. The categorical axes are arranged on the horizontal plane: one axis lists the model categories “Davinci-003,” “ChatGPT,” and “BARD,” and the other lists the task categories “Inductive,” “Abductive,” “Deductive,” and “Mix” (shown in that order). The vertical value axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale from 0 up to approximately 0.8, with evenly spaced tick marks at about 0.2 intervals (0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each model–task combination is represented by a single vertical bar rendered with a blue-to-yellow gradient (darker blue near the base transitioning toward yellow near the top), with no separate legend. For Davinci-003, the bars are approximately 0.33 (Inductive), 0.48 (Abductive), 0.78 (Deductive), and 0.80 (Mix). For ChatGPT, the bars are approximately 0.15 (Inductive), 0.32 (Abductive), 0.50 (Deductive), and 0.78 (Mix). For BARD, the bars are approximately 0.40 (Inductive), 0.36 (Abductive), 0.72 (Deductive), and 0.76 (Mix). The bars are displayed as a regular grid (one bar per intersection of model and task category), the category orders appear fixed as labeled rather than sorted by bar height, and there are no visible callouts, outlines, or annotations emphasizing particular bars.
